title: Aromatic Australian Salmon Crumble
description: A nutty, crumbly salmon dish with tamarind glaze that doubles as a hangover cure.
instructions: Heat 10ml oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sear salmon fillets for 3-4 minutes per side until golden, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil, garlic, and a pinch of salt; sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in tamarind paste, lemon juice, and a splash of water, simmering for 2 minutes to create a tangy glaze.
While the glaze reduces, combine ground almonds, coconut flour, toasted panko, and pepper in a bowl, seasoning with salt to taste.
Return salmon to the skillet, spooning some glaze over each fillet, and cover; cook for 2 more minutes to reheat.
Sprinkle the crumb mixture evenly over the salmon, pressing lightly to adhere.
Transfer the skillet to a preheated oven at 180°C and bake for 8 minutes, or until the crumble is golden and the salmon flakes easily.
Garnish with chopped dill before serving hot with a side of steamed greens.
